firing.source: export function limit() { let MAX_SIZE = 10; return MAX_SIZE * 2; }

findings.message: The variable "MAX_SIZE" is a value, so spell it in lowerCamelCase: "maxSize". Values are spelled in lowerCamelCase and types in UpperCamelCase, so a reader tells which is which at a glance, and an underscore inside a name marks a word boundary the camel case already marks.

firing.fixedSource: export function limit() { let maxSize = 10; return maxSize * 2; }
